answer_1.quote: We explore the task of providing open-ended feedback to improve story writing ... We create a new dataset consisting of stories ... and model-generated feedback.

answer_2.quote: We run several automatic metrics on the generated feedback to describe the output and evaluate its quality ... we also measure the diversity of the feedback by looking at the trigram repetition between a piece of feedback and all other feedback in that subset (3-gramR) ... we also report BERTScore and the percentage of feedback containing the phrase "perfect as-is".

answer_4.quote: Participants annotated 1,920 pieces of feedback, randomly selected ... We collected 3 human annotations for each piece of feedback.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators answered multiple-choice questions covering sanity-check, feedback-type, perfect-agree, correctness, error-detection, specificity, and relevance.
